meanings: Of Their Raising (III.1, Part One: 'their raising')
derivation: a phrase: so their(+S) + Yaldol S·galdol 'building; raising a work' (gald 'build, raise a work' + -Ol; g > y before a vowel, §3.3). A title leaves out the English 'Of', as the lexicon's own titles do (O1118 Kethow sa re yal nadhumat, 'Of the Keep That Was Forgotten'); the softening is the canon's re yald; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: Of Their Fall (III.1, Part Two: 'their falling')
derivation: a phrase: so their(+S) + Ommol falling (omm 'fall; collapse' + -Ol; a vowel is unchanged by the softening, §3.3), built as S05-01; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: Part One (of a telling laid in two: 'the first half')
derivation: a phrase: Saed 'half; a part' (*seʔd-, reserve) + Hosast 'first' (hos + -Ast), the ordinal after its noun as in et vess hosast; a tale laid in two parts is laid in two halves; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: Part Two (of a telling laid in two: 'the second half')
derivation: a phrase: Saed 'half; a part' + Pawast 'second' (pa + -Ast, the glide w after a vowel), as S05-03; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the Homecomings (III.1: the True Men's captions added under the havens' names as each came home); homecomings
derivation: mymmyl 'a homecoming' (O1453: mymm 'return, come back' (*muʔmm-, reserve) + -Ol) + -Ath (plural; slender -eth), a verbal noun made plural as Hethyleth 'the Knowings' in Flennath Hethyleth (O0625); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

orrowen: Cadhan o hosen re yal cadhat lona
meanings: This we (two) lay as it was laid for us: Halyna's close to a stone leaf (the dual of O0234)
derivation: a phrase: Cadhan lay-1DU (cadh + -An, broad -an, as the canon's re hadhan) + o it(+S) + hosen as + re PST(+S) + yal S·be.PST + cadhat laid + lona at-1DU. The hearth formula of O0238 (Kael, 1SG) and O0234 (1PL) in the dual, because 'where the Book gives Halyna a plural verb, the Orrowen original is dual' (orrowen_v2 §3.9 item 1; §12: 'Halyna are always two'); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the Bearer of Branches (a Throne: Leavaren, in the wall's words; the soldiers' Hydra)
derivation: a phrase: Lymmerd 'a bearer' (O1314: lymm 'bring' + -Ard) + Yendeth S·gendeth 'shoots from a stump, branches' (gend (*geʔnd-, reserve) + -Ath; g > y before a vowel), the construct (§3.2), built as Molt Hyll renders Thaesaen (O1418); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

derivation: a phrase: Meskdhrenn 'the grain of wood' (O1383: mesk + S trenn) + sa REL(+S) + lilv 'go soft, rot' (*liʔlf-, reserve; l unchanged), a relative epithet as Sulter sa vorr 'the boat that burns' (O2425); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the Burning (a Throne: Esthaer, in the wall's words; the soldiers' Magma Titan)
derivation: vorrol 'burning' (O2785: vorr 'fire; burn' (*forr-) + -Ol) used as a name; a name takes no article (§3.2); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the Long Winter (a Throne: Eirlenth, in the wall's words; the soldiers' Frost Wyrm)
derivation: a phrase: Grem 'winter' (*grem-) + Sell 'long' (*sell-), the quality after its noun and unmutated (§3.3); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the Blood of the Sky (a Throne: Naelthar, in the wall's words; the soldiers' Storm King)
derivation: a phrase: Lorr 'blood' (*lorr-) + Helv 'the sky' (*half-; h unchanged as the softened possessor), the construct (§3.2); it chimes with Lodh Helv, the Aetherbond; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the Silvered (a Throne: Neivaere, in the wall's words; the soldiers' Crystal Lich)
derivation: lennet 'silvered' (O1177: lenn 'silver' (*lenn-) + -At) used as a name; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: the drums: the soldiers' word for the thunder-tongue knocking out of the grey
derivation: a phrase: et the + drunnatath drum-PL (O0513 drunnat 'a drum, a struck thing': drunn 'knock, strike' (*drunn-) + -At; + -Ath, broad -ath); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

meanings: a hand's breadth ('the breadth of a hand')
derivation: a phrase: ryssyth 'breadth' (O2150: ryss (*ruʔss-, reserve) + -Oth) + yarl S·garl 'a hand' (*garl-; g > y before a vowel), the construct (§3.2), as pa yarl; unit S05 (III.1, wf8)

orrowen: Nath gemment et trenneth; re hethym pana
meanings: The tales do not agree; I have kept both (Seren's line: the foreword's 'Where the tales do not agree, I have kept both', added in her hand under III.1)
derivation: a phrase: Nath NEG(+N) + gemment N·cemm-3PL 'meet, agree' (as O1680 nath gemm; a plural subject takes the plural ending) + et the + trenneth tale-PL (trenn + -Ath) + re PST(+S) + hethym S·keth-1SG 'hold, keep' + pana 'both' (*pa-); unit S05 (III.1, wf8)
